subject: pri-info-td
title: (R)PRI.INFO.TD.------TRS.
description: Diagram in the Extended Functionalism (II) section (EXT.F(II)-6), opening Braxton's argument about creative music's seventies trajectory and decentralization. (R)PRI-INFO-TD (the reality of principle information tendencies) is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what real principle information tendencies look like when crossed with transition in the seventies' context — where, per the prose, the AACM's separateness from the New York post-Ayler thrust bears on the concept of decentralization. POL-DY (political dynamics) branches from the main line and opens into CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) → ALT-D (alternative definitions). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) branches from the main line and opens into PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism); ALT-F opens into ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) → LANG (language).
